CreateSandbox.templateID: Sandbox template ID. Supports the templateID:tag format to specify a particular tag version of the template.
CreateSandbox.timeout: Sandbox idle timeout in seconds. Omitted or 0 means 300; maximum is 604800; -1 means a permanent sandbox.
CreateSandbox.metadata: Sandbox labels. Keys starting with baidubce_ are platform-reserved and validated, e.g. baidubce_cpuCores (1–16) and baidubce_memoryGb (1–64) override the template spec; baidubce_sandboxGraceTime (0–60 minutes), baidubce_persistenceMode (snapshot or data_persistence), baidubce_dataPersistenceSizeGb (5–4096); baidubce_securityGroupId and baidubce_enterpriseSecurityGroupId are mutually exclusive, and exactly one of them is required when baidubce_subnetId is set.
CreateSandbox.secure: Whether to enable data-plane authentication. When true, envdAccessToken is returned and must be included to access the sandbox; otherwise envdAccessToken is an empty string.
CreateSandbox.allow_internet_access: Whether to allow the sandbox to access the public internet.
CreateSandbox.allowInternetAccess: Camel-case form of allow_internet_access (E2B-compatible, deprecated). If both are provided with different values, returns 400.
CreateSandbox.network: Sandbox egress policy (domain-level allowlist/denylist). Returns 400 if rules are invalid; if policy enforcement fails, the sandbox is deleted and an error is returned.
CreateSandbox.network.allowOut: Domains (supports *.example.com wildcards), IPs, or CIDRs allowed for egress, up to 128 entries. The allowlist takes precedence over the denylist.
CreateSandbox.network.denyOut: Domains, IPs, or CIDRs denied for egress, up to 128 entries.
CreateSandbox.autoPause: Whether to automatically pause (instead of delete) after timeout. Defaults to false.
CreateSandbox.autoResume: Auto-resume configuration after pausing. Takes effect only when autoPause is true.
CreateSandbox.autoResume.enabled: Whether to automatically resume a paused sandbox when it is accessed. Defaults to false.
CreateSandbox.runtimeType: Runtime type. Optional value kata; omitting it uses the default CRIU runtime. Only allowlisted accounts can specify kata; otherwise returns 400.
CreateSandbox.volumeMounts: List of NFS volumes mounted to the sandbox, up to 10. Not supported by the kata runtime or multi-container templates; returns 400 if provided.
CreateSandbox.volumeMounts.name: Volume name, corresponding to the volume name registered via the create-volume API. Required.
CreateSandbox.volumeMounts.path: Mount path inside the container. Must be an absolute path. Required.
CreateSandbox.volumeMounts.subPath: Subdirectory under the NFS export directory. Supports the {{sandboxID}} template variable.
CreateSandbox.volumeMounts.readOnly: Whether to mount as read-only. Defaults to false.
